items.text:
Waste of time and money, honestly.

I respect the developer for putting time and effort into an indie project, but looking back on it, Dinner Date aged pretty poorly. The plot feels extremely plain, the pacing drags, and what once may have seemed deep now mostly just comes across as dull and uneventful.

To make matters worse, the graphics and presentation are fairly buggy as well.

Maybe it was more interesting for its time, but nowadays it is just kind of boring.
items.text_zh:
说实话，浪费时间和金钱。

我尊重开发者为独立项目投入的时间和精力，但回过头来看，《晚餐约会》老化得相当糟糕。剧情感觉极其平淡，节奏拖沓，曾经可能显得深刻的东西现在大多只是让人觉得沉闷无事。

更糟的是，画面和呈现也相当有bug。

也许在它那个时代更有趣，但如今它只是有点无聊。

observations.evidence: the graphics and presentation are fairly buggy as well
observations.evidence_zh: 画面和呈现也相当多漏洞
